links.title: Resident Visas for Foreign Spouses of R.O.C.(Taiwan) Citizens Having Household Registration
Detailed Information on Republic of China Resident Visas

docs.text: Completed and signed application form (filled in online at visawebapp.boca.gov.tw)
Two colour passport-size photos (45 x 35 mm) taken within 6 months, white background
Passport valid for 6 months with blank pages (original and photocopy)
Health certificate issued within 3 months (original and photocopy)
Proof of no criminal record from the applicant's country (original and photocopy, authenticated)
Marriage registration or marriage certificate (original and photocopy, authenticated)
R.O.C. (Taiwan) Household Registration certificate issued within 3 months showing the marriage
Other supporting documents, case by case
